headline: Big Tech Divergence Splits S&P 500 into Oversold and Overbought Territory
summary: A historic divergence has split the U.S. stock market, causing the benchmark S&P 500 index to tumble into oversold territory while nearly half of its constituent stocks remained overbought.
why: The S&P 500 is a primary benchmark for U.S. equities, and divergences between headline index movements and underlying stock breadth can signal concentration risks and shifts in market momentum for institutional portfolios.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index itself tumbled into oversold territory according to market data.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
